summary: This tutorial covers creating custom animations in LibreOffice Impress, using a GNU Linux system with version 334 of the LibreOffice suite. To start, open a presentation file and select a text box to apply custom animation. Click on the "Custom Animation" button in the slide menu, then choose an entrance effect like diagonal lines or wedges. You can adjust the speed and order of animations. For example, you can set one animation to slow and another to medium speed. To preview multiple animations, hold Shift while selecting them. You can also change the animation order and properties for each element. The tutorial demonstrates adjusting delays and directions for animations, showing how these changes affect the overall presentation flow.
